prompts.fridge: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A 1536x1024 landscape educational sticker-book background, straight-on realistic photograph of a clean modern white refrigerator standing in a softly lit pale kitchen. The refrigerator is very large centered, fills 90% image height. Main compartment door fully open to the RIGHT, camera looks straight into the empty interior. Exactly three broad EMPTY shelves inside with clear flat front edges and an EMPTY transparent vegetable drawer at bottom; interior takes middle 40% of image width, from x400 to x1000 roughly. Door has three EMPTY door bins on right x1030-1320. All compartments easily visible and spacious for placing food stickers. White plastic and clear glass, gentle light, no food, no bottles, no text, no people. Simple small kitchen surroundings only, no clutter.
prompts.wardrobe: Use case: photorealistic-natural. A 1536x1024 landscape educational sticker-book background, straight-on realistic photograph of a large open pale oak child's wardrobe against a warm ivory bedroom wall with pale wood floor. Wardrobe fills 85% width and 90% height, both doors fully open outward and interiors visible straight on. Inside left half: horizontal clothes rail near top at 25% height, empty space under it, then two broad empty shelves at 60% and 78% height. Inside right half: four broad EMPTY open cubbies with horizontal shelves, for folded clothing, bags and hats. Bottom space for shoes. Everything empty, NO hangers or clothes or objects. Clear shelf edges, clean realistic materials and soft daylight, no person, no text. Composition centered and nearly orthographic for placing stickers.
prompts.storage-items: Use case: product-mockup. Produce a square 1536x1536 actual transparent PNG sticker atlas, EXACTLY SIXTEEN separate photorealistic objects in strict FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, one object fully inside each 384x384 cell with generous 25px transparent gaps. All complete silhouettes, no overlapping or clipping. Row 1 left to right: a white milk carton with blue top no text; a sealed clear water bottle with blue cap no text; three red apples together; a shallow carton containing six eggs. Row 2: a small white yogurt cup with foil lid no text; a small yellow cheese block on a plain wrapper; two orange carrots together; a clear bottle of orange juice with orange cap no text. Row 3: a neatly folded yellow T-shirt; neatly folded blue jeans; neatly folded blue pajamas; a neatly paired white socks pair. Row 4: a red baseball cap front view; a small yellow school backpack front view; a pair of small blue sneakers front view; a folded blue bath towel. Real photographed products with natural textures, isolated cutout alpha transparency, no backdrop, no table, no grid, no words, no surrounding shadow. Objects must sit centered in separate cells. Food first eight, clothing last eight.
prompts.dress-base: Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image is the familiar boy in this AAC app, especially the standing boy at TOP LEFT. Create ONE new full-body straight-on studio photograph of this same smiling Korean boy, matching his face, hair and age, for a children's clothing sticker activity. Landscape 1536x1024. Place boy centered at x768, full body from head near y65 to bare feet near y970, height about900pixels. Standing upright with legs slightly apart, BOTH arms relaxed but angled slightly away from torso so wrists visible. Looking straight toward camera. He is already fully dressed in a plain slim white short-sleeve T-shirt and plain navy shorts, barefoot. No underwear or nudity. Soft off-white studio background with tiny grounding shadow, no props, no text, no other people, no extra panels. All fingers and toes in frame. Preserve identity from reference. Shirt and shorts simple close-fitting so later clothing stickers can cover them.
prompts.dress-items: Use case: product-mockup with reference alignment. Reference photo shows the exact boy to dress; use his front-facing standing pose and limb angles to shape clothing, but DO NOT include the boy or any skin/body parts in the output. Create a 1536x1536 transparent PNG clothing sticker sheet with exactly NINE isolated photographed garments/accessories, strict THREE COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, each in its own 512x512 cell, at least 24px transparent margin. Row1: blue full-length jogger trousers FRONT VIEW with two legs slightly apart, waistband broad enough to cover the boy's navy shorts, ankle cuffs; a mustard yellow short sleeve T-shirt FRONT VIEW with slight outward sleeve angles matching his arms, shaped as worn not folded, round neck; a PAIR of white ankle socks as worn, front view toes pointing toward camera, separated by a gap matching his feet. Row2: a PAIR of blue sneakers as worn, FRONT view toes pointing toward camera, feet separated; a pair of round blue eyeglasses seen straight from front, clear lenses and transparent openings; a red baseball cap seen FRONT view as worn, curved visor pointing toward camera. Row3: a blue child's wristwatch, front dial and short closed band seen from front as worn on a wrist; a small green crossbody satchel with its narrow diagonal shoulder strap fully visible rising toward the upper RIGHT and pouch at lower LEFT, straight-on as worn against a torso; a simple orange silicone bracelet, front view as worn around a wrist. All are photorealistic isolated items with fully transparent alpha background, no words or labels or grid, no floor, no human figure, no visible hands or body parts, no shadow backdrop. Make the trouser and shirt silhouettes fit the reference boy's pose when scaled onto him. Each item wholly contained within its cell, no touching adjacent cells. Clean edges, soft studio light.
